title: Diplomatic Immunity
logline: A strictly enforced medical quarantine is repeatedly bypassed because a centuries-old law classifies a specific luxury good as vital diplomatic cargo.

roles.description: Desperately trying to contain a localized outbreak while bound by archaic port laws.
Trapped inside the quarantine zone, out of real supplies, treating patients with industrial cleaners.
Exploiting a legal loophole to move luxury goods through the blockade at a massive markup.
A fast courier vessel running under false diplomatic colors.
A sprawling orbital habitat completely cut off from the rest of the system.
A heavily armed customs satellite that enforces the medical boundary.
The sector's underfunded and bureaucratically paralyzed medical authority.

public_situation: The {role:health_ministry} has sealed off the {role:quarantine_station} due to a highly contagious outbreak, forbidding all ships from docking.
private_truth: The blockade forces are legally compelled to allow ships carrying certain ceremonial luxuries to pass uninspected, allowing wealthy citizens inside to buy comfort while the poor suffocate.

beats.public_change: The inspector publicly declares they will seize any ship violating the quarantine.

missions.reason: Needs an independent scan of the luxury vessels bypassing the blockade to prove they are carrying unlisted contraband.
missions.private_fact: The inspector cannot officially request this scan without violating the diplomatic immunity law.

missions.reason: Begs the pilot to purchase basic medical supplies and securely dock at the blockade checkpoint to hand them over to sympathetic guards.
missions.private_fact: The guards have promised to load the supplies onto the next diplomatic ship.

beats.public_change: The smugglers realize they are being tracked by an independent pilot.

missions.reason: The smuggler hails the pilot, offering to safely transport the medical supplies through their legal loophole if the pilot destroys their scanned data.
missions.private_fact: The smuggler plans to sell the supplies to the wealthy inside rather than giving them to the doctor.

beats.public_change: The smuggler prepares to cross the blockade under diplomatic cover, holding both luxury goods and the player's medicine.

missions.reason: Hires the pilot to intercept the smuggler at the blockade checkpoint and demand the medicine back before the smuggler takes it inside to sell to the elites.
missions.private_fact: If this fails, the doctor will be forced to shut down the clinic entirely.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has recovered the medicine. They can hand it over to the doctor, or sell it directly to the wealthy elites who have circumvented the law.

options.label: Deliver the medicine to the clinic
Auction the medicine to the highest bidder

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the smuggler's offer but steals the medicine back for the doctor.
resolutions.summary: The doctor treats the poorest victims of the outbreak, stabilizing the zone. The smuggler continues to exploit the loophole, but lives are saved.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot used a smuggler's loophole to sneak a massive payload of meds to a stranded clinic.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the smuggler ship instead of taking the offer.
resolutions.summary: The loophole is violently closed. The quarantine holds, but without the medicine, the doctor's clinic collapses.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reports the smuggler's hold as clean.
resolutions.summary: The legal loophole remains open. The wealthy ride out the quarantine in luxury, while the station's poor suffer immensely.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the medicine to the elites.
resolutions.summary: The pilot makes a massive profit. The elites survive comfortably, the clinic collapses, and the quarantine eventually lifts.

loose_threads.detail: The diplomatic seals used to bypass the blockade perfectly match a batch stolen from a neighbouring system three years ago.
The station's environmental logs show the pathogen was introduced into the ventilation exactly twenty minutes after the inspector was assigned.

radio_hooks: {role:port_inspector} demands end to 'archaic luxury exemptions' during outbreak.
Black market prices for basic medical supplies inside {role:quarantine_station} skyrocket.

voice_direction.port_inspector: Stressed, rapid delivery. Speaks entirely in citations and regulations.
voice_direction.stranded_doctor: Exhausted cadence. Sentences trail off without finishing.
voice_direction.smuggler_captain: Smooth, practiced rhythm. Uses legal terms incorrectly but confidently.
